rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best without changing data, validation cadence, export format, or the final exact int8+zlib path. The close capped-profile miss suggests the shallower recurrent tail replay may be over-strong at final eval relative to its 0.35 training gain, so this run uses a softer 0.86 eval cap and gradually bridges training gains toward that profile only during the quant-aware endgame. It is compile-stable, byte-neutral, and directly targets final roundtrip behavior rather than loss proxies.
title: Quant-Aware Soft-Capped Tail Recurrence Bridge
